paper.title: Tight Guarantees for Interactive Decision Making with the Decision-Estimation Coefficient

settings.name_in_paper: Decision Making with Structured Observations (DMSO), regret framework
unmapped: learner also receives an observation o in addition to the reward r, (r,o) ~ M*(pi); framework covers structured bandits and episodic RL with function approximation
model class M is known and contains the true model (realizability)
settings.definition_quote: The protocol consists of $T$ rounds. For each round $t=1,\ldots,T$: The learner selects a decision $\pi\ind{t}\in\Pi$ ... The learner receives a reward $r\ind{t}\in\cR\subseteq\bbR$ and observation $o\ind{t}\in\cO$ sampled via $(r\ind{t},o\ind{t})\sim{}\Mstar(\pi\ind{t})$ ... We assume throughout the paper that $\cR=\brk*{0,1}$

settings.name_in_paper: Decision Making with Structured Observations (DMSO), PAC framework
unmapped: learner also receives an observation o in addition to the reward r; framework covers structured bandits and episodic RL
model class M is known and contains the true model (realizability)
risk measured as E_{pihat~p}[f*(pi*) - f*(pihat)] of a final randomized decision after T rounds
settings.definition_quote: For PAC guarantees, we are only concerned with final suboptimality. After rounds $t=1,\ldots,T$ complete, the learner can use all of the data collected to select a final decision $\pihat$ ... $\RiskDM\ldef{}\En_{\pihat\sim{}p}\brk*{\fmstar(\pimstar) - \fmstar(\pihat)}$.

settings.name_in_paper: Multi-armed bandit with Bernoulli rewards (lower bound example)
settings.definition_quote: Let $A\in\bbN$ and $\Pi=\crl{1,\ldots,A}$. Consider the multi-armed bandit model class $\cM=\crl*{M_1,\ldots,M_A}$ consisting models of the form $M_i(\pi)=\Ber(f_i(\pi))$

symbols.dec_c_pac: constrained PAC Decision-Estimation Coefficient of the model class, sup over reference models in conv(M), as a function of radius
symbols.eps_lower: radius c/sqrt(T*C_T) with c a small numerical constant
symbols.C_T: log(min(T, V(M))), V(M) a density-ratio bound of the class

source.label: thm:pac_lower
source.quote: Let $\vepslowerT \ldef c\cdot\frac{1}{\sqrt{T\Ct}}$, where $c>0$ is a sufficiently small numerical constant and $C\ldef{}48\sqrt{2}$. For all $T\in\bbN$ such that the condition $\deccpac[\vepslowerT](\MM)\geq{}C\cdot\vepslowerT$ is satisfied, it holds that for any PAC algorithm, there exists a model in $\cM$ such that $\E\left[\RiskDM\right] \geq \bigom(1) \cdot \sup_{\Mbar\in\cMall}\deccpac[\vepslowerT](\cMu,\Mbar) \geq \bigom(1) \cdot \deccpac[\vepslowerT](\MM)$.

results.notes: General complexity-measure lower bound; stronger form with sup over arbitrary reference models also stated.

symbols.dec_c_reg: constrained regret Decision-Estimation Coefficient sup_{Mbar in conv(M)} dec(M ∪ {Mbar}, Mbar), as function of radius

conditions: dec_c_reg(eps_lower) >= C*eps_lower for universal constant C

source.label: thm:regret_lower
source.quote: There exist universal constants $C, C' > 0$ and $c, c' > 0$ such that the following holds. Let $\vepslowerT \ldef c\cdot\frac{1}{\sqrt{T\Ct}}$. For all $T\in\bbN$ such that the condition $\deccreg[\vepslowerT](\MM)\geq{}C \cdot \vepslowerT$ is satisfied, it holds that for any regret minimization algorithm, there exists a model in $\cM$ such that $\En\brk*{\RegDM} \geq{} c'\cdot\sup_{\Mbar\in\cMall}\deccreg[\vepslowerT](\cMu,\Mbar)\cdot{}\frac{T}{\log T} - C' \cdot \frac{\sqrt{T}}{\log(T)}$ ...

results.notes: Regret defined as sum_t E_{pi~p_t}[f*(pi*) - f*(pi)], hence pseudo_regret.

symbols.dec_c_pac: constrained PAC DEC sup_{Mbar in conv(M)} dec(M, Mbar) as function of radius
symbols.Est_bar: Est_H(2T/ceil(log 2/delta), delta/(4 ceil(log 2/delta))), online Hellinger estimation error bound of the oracle

source.label: thm:pac_upper
source.quote: Fix $\delta \in \left(0, \frac{1}{10} \right)$ and $T \in \BN$. Suppose that \Cref{ass:realizability,ass:hellinger_oracle} hold ... With $\vepsupperT \ldef 8\sqrt{\frac{\lceil \log 2/\delta \rceil}{T} \cdot \EstBar}$, \Cref{alg:pac} guarantees that with probability at least $1-\delta$, $\RiskDM \leq \deccpac[\vepsupperT](\MM)$.

results.notes: Holds with probability 1-delta. For finite classes Est <= O(log(|M|/delta)).

symbols.dec_c_pac: constrained PAC DEC as function of radius

source.label: thm:pac_upper
source.quote: Thus, the expected risk achieved by \Cref{alg:pac} is bounded by $\E[\RiskDM] \leq \deccpac[\vepsupperT](\MM)  + \delta.$

results.notes: Expectation version of the same theorem.

symbols.dec_c_reg: constrained regret DEC sup_{Mbar in conv(M)} dec(M ∪ {Mbar}, Mbar) as function of radius
symbols.eps_upper: C*sqrt(Est_bar*log(1/delta)/T) for a numerical constant C
symbols.Est_bar: Est_H(T, delta^2), constrained online Hellinger estimation error bound

conditions: regularity of DEC: dec_eps <= C_reg^2 dec_{eps/C_reg} for all eps in (0,2) (Assumption 4)

source.label: thm:regret_upper
source.quote: Fix $T \in \BN$ and $\delta \in (0,1)$. Suppose that \Cref{ass:realizability,ass:hellinger_oracle_constrained,asm:dec} hold, and let $\EstBar\ldef\Est(T, \delta^2)$. Then \pref{alg:regret}, with $C_1>0$ chosen appropriately, ensures that with probability at least $1-\delta$, $\RegDM \leq  \deccreg[\vepsupperT](\MM)\cdot{}O\prn*{T \log(T)}  +  O\prn[\Big]{\sqrt{T \log(1/\delta) \cdot \EstBar}}$, where $\vepsupperT \ldef C\cdot\sqrt{\frac{ \EstBar\cdot\log(1/\delta)}{T}}$ for a numerical constant $C>0$.

results.notes: Regret quantity is sum of expected per-round gaps under p_t, bound holds w.p. 1-delta. Constants of regularity condition hidden in O.

conditions: hard instances: Bernoulli arms with means 1/2 + Delta*1{pi=i}, Delta proportional to eps_lower*sqrt(K)
results.notes: Informal example derived from Theorem regret_lower; A = number of arms = K.
